legal_ref: Loi modifiée du 12 février 1979 concernant la TVA, art. 39 (3); temporary 16% for 1.1.2023–31.12.2023 by Loi du 26 octobre 2022 (Mémorial A n° 534), art. 1
quote: à partir du 1er janvier 2024, les taux de TVA suivants reviennent à leur niveau d’avant le 1er janvier 2023 : ● Taux normal : 17% (16% pendant l’année 2023) — From 1 January 2024 the standard rate returns to 17% (it was 16% during 2023). [Loi du 26 octobre 2022 art. 1: '... le taux normal de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée est fixé à seize pour cent ... pour la période du 1er janvier 2023 au 31 décembre 2023 inclus.']
source_title: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED), Circulaire N° 812-1 du 27 décembre 2023 'Taux de TVA ; Exigibilité de la taxe'; temporary law: Mémorial A n° 534 du 26.10.2022, https://data.legilux.public.lu/filestore/eli/etat/leg/loi/2022/10/26/a534/jo/fr/pdfa/eli-etat-leg-loi-2022-10-26-a534-jo-fr-pdfa.pdf

reduced_rates.scope: intermediate rate, Annex C: certain wines (≤13% alcohol), solid mineral fuels/mineral oils/wood fuel, washing preparations, printed advertising material, securities custody and management, credit management (per TEDB)
reduced rate, Annex A: gas and electricity, district heating, hairdressing, minor repairs of bicycles/shoes/clothing, plants and flowers, certain art and collectors' items (per TEDB)

super-reduced rate, Annex B: most foodstuffs, non-alcoholic beverages, medicines and medical equipment, books and press (incl. electronic), children's clothing and footwear, passenger transport, accommodation and restaurant services excluding alcohol, housing construction/renovation for main residence (per TEDB)

notes: 17% applied before the temporary 2023 reduction (since 1 January 2015) and again from 1 January 2024. Zero rate (exemption with deduction) for exports and intra-EU supplies; TEDB lists 0% for certain passenger transport. TEDB (situation 2026-07-01) shows 17%, 14%, 8%, 3% — consistent. No enacted future change found.
unverified: Text of art. 39 of the consolidated 1979 law not read directly (Legilux site requires JavaScript; consolidated PDF not located); standard rate taken from the AED circular and the 2022 Mémorial
Reduced-rate scopes and the 3% super-reduced rate taken from TEDB, not from Annexes A/B/C
